---
title: "National data for the stock coordinator"
date: "Report date `r format(Sys.Date())`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
    theme:
      version: 5
      primary: "#2a78d6"
      base_font: "Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"
      heading_font: "Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"
      code_font: "Consolas, Menlo, monospace"
      font_scale: 0.95
params:
  input: "H8ExampleEE1"
  repoDir: "../.."
  stockCode: "spr.27.22-32"
  species: 126425
  stockAreas: !r c("27.3.b.23", "27.3.c.22", "27.3.d.24", "27.3.d.25", "27.3.d.26", "27.3.d.27", "27.3.d.28.1", "27.3.d.28.2", "27.3.d.29", "27.3.d.30", "27.3.d.31", "27.3.d.32")
  filterToStock: TRUE
  lengthBin: 5
  topMetiers: 7
---

```{css, echo = FALSE}
:root {
  --ink: #1f2933;
  --ink-2: #4b5563;
  --muted: #6b7280;
  --line: #e5e7eb;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f6f8fb;
  --accent: #2a78d6;
  --accent-soft: #e8f1fc;
  --warn-soft: #fdf1e8;
}
body { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); line-height: 1.55; }
.main-container { max-width: 1180px; }
h1.title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.9rem; margin-top: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
h4.date { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 400; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
h1:not(.title) {
  font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 650; margin-top: 2.6rem; padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line);
}
h1 .header-section-number { color: var(--accent); margin-right: 0.35rem; }
h2 { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 1.8rem; }

/* banner */
.banner {
  display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1f4f8f 0%, #2a78d6 100%);
  color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.2rem 1.6rem; margin: 0.4rem 0 1rem;
}
.banner-year { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-right: 1.6rem;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
.banner-year span { font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.85; }
.banner-year strong { font-size: 2.6rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; }
.banner-meta div { font-size: 0.95rem; opacity: 0.95; }
.banner-meta .banner-stock { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 650; opacity: 1; margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }

/* key figure tiles */
.tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0 0 1.4rem; }
.tile { background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; }
.tile-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.tile-value { font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.25; }
.tile-note { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--ink-2); }

/* tables */
.table { font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; border-color: var(--line); }
.table caption { caption-side: top; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0 0 0.5rem; text-align: left; }
.table thead th { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line) !important; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: bottom; }
.table td { vertical-align: top; padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; }
.table-striped > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(odd) > * { --bs-table-accent-bg: #fafbfc; }
.overview td:first-child { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; width: 15rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.overview tr.groupRow td, .overview td[colspan] {
  background: var(--accent-soft) !important; color: #1f4f8f !important; font-weight: 650;
  text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
.scroll-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; }
.scroll-wrap .table { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* figures */
.figure, p > img, .section > p > img {
  display: block; margin: 0.6rem 0 1.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.4rem; background: #fff; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }

/* notes */
.note { background: var(--accent-soft); border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; margin: 0.8rem 0 1.2rem; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 0.9rem; }
.note p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* toc */
#TOC { font-size: 0.88rem; border: none; }
.tocify .list-group-item { border: none; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; }
.tocify .list-group-item.active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: #1f4f8f; font-weight: 600; }
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# fixed categorical order (blue, orange, aqua, yellow, magenta, green, violet, red)

# html tables with kableExtra. Column names are shown with spaces.
kbl <- function(x, caption = NULL, escape = TRUE, class = NULL, ...) {
  k <- kableExtra::kbl(x, format = "html", caption = caption, escape = escape,
                       col.names = gsub("_", " ", names(x)),
                       format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)
  k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                                 full_width = TRUE, position = "left", font_size = NULL)
  if (!is.null(class)) k <- sub("<table class=\"", paste0("<table class=\"", class, " "), k)
  structure(paste0("<div class=\"scroll-wrap\">", k, "</div>"), class = "knit_asis")
}
show <- function(k) cat(k, "\n\n")

pct <- function(n, N) {
  N <- rep_len(N, length(n))
  out <- round(100 * n / N, 1)
  out[!(N > 0)] <- NA_real_
  out
}
nOfNpct <- function(n, N, digits = 0) {
  paste0(format(round(n, digits), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "/",
         format(round(N, digits), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
         " (", pct(n, N), "%)")
}
fmtT <- function(x) format(round(x, 1), big.mark = ",", nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)
fmtN <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
listCounts <- function(x, unit = "") {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("none")
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  paste0(names(tab), " (", as.integer(tab), unit, ")", collapse = ", ")
}
listTonnes <- function(group, t) {
  d <- data.table(g = group, t = t)[!is.na(g) & g != "", .(t = sum(t)), by = g][order(-t)]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return("none")
  paste0(d$g, " (", fmtT(d$t), " t)", collapse = ", ")
}
nr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) 0L else nrow(x)
pctLab <- function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")
```

```{r load}
# ---- input -----------------------------------------------------------------
# A packaged RDBESDataObject (by name), an .rds file holding one, or the
# RDBES download (folder or zip files) read with createRDBESDataObject()
loadInput <- function(input) {
  if (grepl("\\.rds$", input, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(readRDS(input))
  }
  if (file.exists(input)) {
    return(createRDBESDataObject(input = input))
  }
  get(input)
}
raw <- loadInput(params$input)
validateRDBESDataObject(raw, strict = TRUE)

hier <- unique(raw$DE$DEhierarchy)
if (length(hier) != 1) {
  stop("The input holds more than one hierarchy (", paste(hier, collapse = ", "),
       "). This report is for one hierarchy.")
}
dataYear <- unique(raw$DE$DEyear)
if (length(dataYear) != 1) {
  stop("The input holds more than one year (", paste(dataYear, collapse = ", "),
       "). This report is for one data year.")
}
country <- unique(raw$SD$SDctry)

# ---- filter to the stock ---------------------------------------------------
# Species: SAspeCode (CS) and CLspecCode (CL).
# Area: the CS table that holds the fishing area of the hierarchy (FOarea in
# hierarchies 1, 2, 3, 10 and 13, LEarea otherwise), CLarea and CEarea.
# SAarea is not used because it is often left empty.
hierTabs <- getTablesInRDBESHierarchy(hier, includeTablesNotInSampHier = FALSE)
csAreaField <- if (hier %in% c(1, 2, 3, 10, 13)) "FOarea" else "LEarea"
dat <- raw
if (isTRUE(params$filterToStock)) {
  dat <- filterRDBESDataObject(dat, fieldsToFilter = c("SAspeCode", "CLspecCode"),
                               valuesToFilter = params$species, killOrphans = TRUE)
  areaFields <- c(csAreaField, "CLarea", "CEarea")
  areaFields <- areaFields[vapply(areaFields, function(f) {
    nr(dat[[substr(f, 1, 2)]]) > 0
  }, logical(1))]
  dat <- filterRDBESDataObject(dat, fieldsToFilter = areaFields,
                               valuesToFilter = params$stockAreas, killOrphans = TRUE)
}
presentTabs <- hierTabs[vapply(hierTabs, function(t) nr(dat[[t]]) > 0, logical(1))]
stageTabs <- setdiff(presentTabs, c("DE", "SD", "FM", "BV"))
psuTab <- stageTabs[1]
unitTab <- stageTabs[max(which(stageTabs == "SS")) - 1]   # stage directly above SS

# ---- species name ----------------------------------------------------------
speciesName <- wormsAphiaRecord$scientificname[match(params$species,
                                                     wormsAphiaRecord$AphiaID)]
if (length(speciesName) == 0 || is.na(speciesName)) speciesName <- "not in wormsAphiaRecord"

# ---- samples with their domain ---------------------------------------------
# getSampleUnits(): one row per lowest-level landings sample with year,
# quarter, month, area, rectangle, metier6 and the live weight (kg) of the
# catch fraction it represents (xSample)
su <- getSampleUnits(dat, species = params$species, catchCat = "Lan", strict = TRUE)
suLog <- attr(su, "ratioLog")
su[, SAid := as.numeric(SAid)]

# ---- fish level biological data --------------------------------------------
BV <- if (nr(dat$BV) > 0) copy(dat$BV) else NULL
FM <- if (nr(dat$FM) > 0) copy(dat$FM) else NULL
fish <- NULL
if (!is.null(BV)) {
  BV[, SAid := as.numeric(SAid)]
  BV[, value := BVvalueMeas]
  # lengths to mm
  isLen <- grepl("^Length", BV$BVtypeMeas)
  isCm <- isLen & grepl("cm", BV$BVvalUnitScale, ignore.case = TRUE)
  BV[isCm, value := as.character(as.numeric(value) * 10)]
  BV[isLen, BVtypeMeas := "Length"]
  fish <- dcast(BV, SAid + FMid + BVfishId ~ BVtypeMeas, value.var = "value",
                fun.aggregate = function(x) x[1], fill = NA)
  for (v in intersect(c("Age", "Length", "WeightMeasured"), names(fish))) {
    set(fish, j = v, value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fish[[v]])))
  }
  # length from the FM class when the fish has no own length (lower hierarchy A)
  if (!is.null(FM) && "FMid" %in% names(fish)) {
    fmL <- FM[grepl("^Length", FMtypeMeas), .(FMid, fmLength = as.numeric(FMclassMeas))]
    fish <- merge(fish, fmL, by = "FMid", all.x = TRUE)
    if (!"Length" %in% names(fish)) fish[, Length := NA_real_]
    fish[is.na(Length), Length := fmLength]
    fish[, fmLength := NULL]
  }
}

# length frequencies: FM counts, else individual BV lengths
lenFreq <- data.table(SAid = numeric(0), Length = numeric(0), n = numeric(0))
if (!is.null(FM)) {
  lenFreq <- FM[grepl("^Length", FMtypeMeas),
                .(SAid = as.numeric(SAid), Length = as.numeric(FMclassMeas),
                  n = as.numeric(FMnumAtUnit))]
}
if (!is.null(fish) && "Length" %in% names(fish)) {
  lenFreq <- rbind(lenFreq,
                   fish[!SAid %in% lenFreq$SAid & !is.na(Length),
                        .(n = as.numeric(.N)), by = .(SAid, Length)])
}

domainCols <- c("SAid", "quarter", "month", "area", "metier6", unitTabId <- paste0(unitTab, "id"))
lenFreq <- merge(lenFreq, su[, ..domainCols], by = "SAid")
if (!is.null(fish)) fish <- merge(fish, su[, ..domainCols], by = "SAid")

perSample <- su[, .(SAid)]
perSample <- merge(perSample, lenFreq[, .(Fish_measured = sum(n)), by = SAid],
                   by = "SAid", all.x = TRUE)
if (!is.null(fish) && "Age" %in% names(fish)) {
  perSample <- merge(perSample, fish[!is.na(Age), .(Fish_aged = .N), by = SAid],
                     by = "SAid", all.x = TRUE)
} else {
  perSample[, Fish_aged := 0]
}
perSample[is.na(Fish_measured), Fish_measured := 0]
perSample[is.na(Fish_aged), Fish_aged := 0]
su <- merge(su, perSample, by = "SAid")

# ---- landings and effort ---------------------------------------------------
CL <- if (nr(dat$CL) > 0) copy(dat$CL) else NULL
CE <- if (nr(dat$CE) > 0) copy(dat$CE) else NULL
if (!is.null(CL)) CL[, t := CLsciWeight / 1000]

# ---- key figures -----------------------------------------------------------
fishMeasured <- sum(su$Fish_measured)
fishAged <- sum(su$Fish_aged)
nSamples <- nrow(su[include == TRUE])
landT <- if (!is.null(CL)) sum(CL[CLcatchCat == "Lan", t]) else NA
```

```{r banner, results = "asis"}
tile <- function(label, value, note = "") {
  paste0("<div class=\"tile\"><div class=\"tile-label\">", label,
         "</div><div class=\"tile-value\">", value,
         "</div><div class=\"tile-note\">", note, "</div></div>")
}
sampQ <- if (nSamples > 0) paste0("Q", sort(unique(su[include == TRUE, quarter])), collapse = ", ") else "none"
cat("<div class=\"banner\">",
    "<div class=\"banner-year\"><span>Data year</span><strong>", dataYear, "</strong></div>",
    "<div class=\"banner-meta\">",
    "<div class=\"banner-stock\">", params$stockCode, "</div>",
    "<div><em>", speciesName, "</em> &middot; AphiaID ", params$species, "</div>",
    "<div>Country ", paste(country, collapse = ", "), " &middot; Hierarchy ", hier,
    " &middot; Institute ", paste(unique(dat$SD$SDinst), collapse = ", "), "</div>",
    "</div></div>", sep = "")
cat("<div class=\"tiles\">",
    tile("Landings", if (is.na(landT)) "no CL" else paste(fmtT(landT), "t"), "CL, catch category Lan"),
    tile("Landings samples", fmtN(nSamples), paste("in", sampQ)),
    tile("Fish measured", fmtN(fishMeasured), "length"),
    tile("Fish aged", fmtN(fishAged),
         "age"),
    "</div>", sep = "")
```

# Overview

```{r overview}
item <- function(Group, Item, Value) data.table(Group = Group, Item = Item, Value = Value)

DE <- dat$DE
SD <- dat$SD
stageText <- vapply(stageTabs, function(tb) {
  d <- dat[[tb]]
  m <- d[[paste0(tb, "selectMeth")]]
  paste0("<b>", tb, "</b> ", paste0(unique(m), " (", classifySelectionMethod(unique(m)), ")",
                                    collapse = ", "))
}, character(1))

csQuarters <- if (nrow(su) > 0) {
  q <- su[, .N, by = quarter][order(quarter)]
  paste0("Q", q$quarter, " (", q$N, " samples)", collapse = ", ")
} else "none"
csMonths <- if (nrow(su) > 0) paste(sort(unique(su$month)), collapse = ", ") else "none"

# sampling dates of the unit directly above SS, else of the PSU
dateField <- c(FO = "FOendDate", LE = "LEdate", FT = "FTarvDate", OS = "OSsamDate")
dateTab <- intersect(c(unitTab, psuTab), names(dateField))[1]
dates <- if (!is.na(dateTab)) as.IDate(dat[[dateTab]][[dateField[[dateTab]]]]) else as.IDate(NA)
dateRange <- if (all(is.na(dates))) "not recorded" else
  paste(format(min(dates, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", format(max(dates, na.rm = TRUE)))

clQuarters <- if (!is.null(CL)) listTonnes(paste0("Q", CL$CLquar), CL$t) else "no CL"
bvTypes <- if (!is.null(dat$BV)) listCounts(dat$BV$BVtypeMeas) else "none"
fmTypes <- if (!is.null(dat$FM)) listCounts(dat$FM$FMtypeMeas) else "none"

slInfo <- if (nr(dat$SL) > 0) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(dat$SL)), function(i) {
    taxa <- dat$IS[SLid == dat$SL$SLid[i], ISsppCode]
    paste0(dat$SL$SLspeclistName[i], " (", dat$SL$SLcatchFrac[i], ", ",
           length(taxa), " taxa, stock species ",
           if (params$species %in% taxa) "included" else "not included", ")")
  }, character(1))
} else "none"

vesselIds <- unique(unlist(lapply(stageTabs, function(tb) {
  if ("VDid" %in% names(dat[[tb]])) dat[[tb]]$VDid
})))
vesselIds <- vesselIds[!is.na(vesselIds)]
vesLen <- if (nr(dat$VD) > 0) listCounts(dat$VD[VDid %in% vesselIds, VDlenCat], " vessels") else "none"

g1 <- "Stock and data"
g2 <- "Sampling design"
g3 <- "Coverage"
g4 <- "Data volume"
ov <- rbind(
  item(g1, "Data year", as.character(dataYear)),
  item(g1, "Country", paste(country, collapse = ", ")),
  item(g1, "Institute", paste(unique(SD$SDinst), collapse = ", ")),
  item(g1, "Stock", params$stockCode),
  item(g1, "Species", paste0("<em>", speciesName, "</em> (AphiaID ", params$species, ")")),
  item(g1, "Stock area", paste(params$stockAreas, collapse = ", ")),
  item(g2, "Hierarchy", paste0(hier, " (", paste(presentTabs, collapse = " &rarr; "), ")")),
  item(g2, "Sampling scheme", paste(unique(DE$DEsampScheme), collapse = ", ")),
  item(g2, "Sampling scheme type", paste(unique(DE$DEsampSchemeType), collapse = ", ")),
  item(g2, "DE strata", paste(unique(DE$DEstratumName), collapse = ", ")),
  item(g2, "Primary sampling unit", psuTab),
  item(g2, "Selection methods", paste(stageText, collapse = "<br>")),
  item(g2, "Lower hierarchy", listCounts(dat$SA$SAlowHierarchy, " samples")),
  item(g2, "Catch fractions sampled (SScatchFra)", listCounts(dat$SS$SScatchFra, " SS")),
  item(g2, "Zeros recorded (SSuseCalcZero)", listCounts(dat$SS$SSuseCalcZero, " SS")),
  item(g2, "Species list", paste(slInfo, collapse = "<br>")),
  item(g3, "Temporal coverage CS", paste0(csQuarters, "<br>months ", csMonths,
                                          "<br>", dateRange)),
  item(g3, "Temporal coverage CL", clQuarters),
  item(g3, "Spatial coverage CS", listCounts(su$area, " samples")),
  item(g3, "Spatial coverage CL", if (!is.null(CL)) listTonnes(CL$CLarea, CL$t) else "no CL"),
  item(g3, "Spatial coverage CE", if (!is.null(CE)) {
    ceA <- CE[, .(d = sum(CEsciDaySea, na.rm = TRUE)), by = CEarea][order(-d)]
    paste0(ceA$CEarea, " (", fmtN(ceA$d), " days at sea)", collapse = ", ")
  } else "no CE"),
  item(g3, "Metiers CS", listCounts(su$metier6, " samples")),
  item(g3, "Metiers CL", if (!is.null(CL)) listTonnes(CL$CLmetier6, CL$t) else "no CL"),
  item(g3, "Catch categories CL", if (!is.null(CL))
    listTonnes(paste(CL$CLcatchCat, CL$CLlandCat), CL$t) else "no CL"),
  item(g4, "Landings (CL, Lan)", if (!is.na(landT)) paste(fmtT(landT), "t") else "no CL"),
  item(g4, "Effort (CE)", if (!is.null(CE))
    paste0(fmtN(sum(CE$CEsciDaySea, na.rm = TRUE)), " days at sea, ",
           fmtN(sum(CE$CEnumDomTrip, na.rm = TRUE)), " trips") else "no CE"),
  item(g4, "Vessels sampled", paste0(length(vesselIds), ", ", vesLen)),
  item(g4, "Landings samples", as.character(nSamples)),
  item(g4, "Fish measured", fmtN(fishMeasured)),
  item(g4, "Fish aged", fmtN(fishAged)),
  item(g4, "Measurements in FM", fmTypes),
  item(g4, "Measurements in BV", bvTypes)
)
k <- kableExtra::kbl(ov[, .(Item, Value)], format = "html", escape = FALSE)
k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = TRUE, position = "left")
for (g in unique(ov$Group)) {
  w <- which(ov$Group == g)
  k <- kableExtra::pack_rows(k, g, min(w), max(w), label_row_css = "")
}
k <- sub("<table class=\"", "<table class=\"overview ", k)
structure(paste0("<div class=\"scroll-wrap\">", k, "</div>"), class = "knit_asis")
```

# Sampling design

```{r design}
des <- rbindlist(lapply(stageTabs, function(tb) {
  d <- dat[[tb]]
  g <- function(s) if (paste0(tb, s) %in% names(d)) d[[paste0(tb, s)]] else rep(NA, nrow(d))
  samp <- g("samp")
  meth <- g("selectMeth")
  strat <- g("stratification")
  nTot <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g("numTotal")))
  nSmp <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g("numSamp")))
  rng <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) "" else
    if (min(x, na.rm = TRUE) == max(x, na.rm = TRUE)) as.character(min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) else
      paste0(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), "&ndash;", max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  data.table(
    Stage = paste0("<b>", tb, "</b>"),
    Records = nrow(d),
    Not_sampled = nOfNpct(sum(samp == "N", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(d)),
    Reasons_not_sampled = listCounts(g("noSampReason")),
    Selection_method = listCounts(meth),
    Design_class = listCounts(classifySelectionMethod(meth)),
    Stratified = nOfNpct(sum(strat == "Y", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(d)),
    Strata = paste(unique(g("stratumName")), collapse = ", "),
    numTotal = rng(nTot),
    numSamp = rng(nSmp)
  )
}))
kbl(des, escape = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("Sampling stages of hierarchy ", hier,
                     ". Design class from classifySelectionMethod(). numTotal and numSamp are the range within the stage."))
```

```{r designStrata}
# One row per record of each sampling stage, nested under its parent record
# (depth first), grouped by the stratum of the primary sampling unit.
nodes <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(stageTabs), function(k) {
  tb <- stageTabs[k]
  d <- dat[[tb]]
  g <- function(s) if (paste0(tb, s) %in% names(d)) d[[paste0(tb, s)]] else rep(NA, nrow(d))
  parCol <- if (k > 1) paste0(stageTabs[k - 1], "id") else NA
  par <- if (k > 1 && parCol %in% names(d)) paste0(stageTabs[k - 1], ":", d[[parCol]]) else
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(d))
  data.table(nodeKey = paste0(tb, ":", d[[paste0(tb, "id")]]), parent = par, level = k,
             Unit = paste(tb, d[[paste0(tb, "id")]]), id = as.numeric(d[[paste0(tb, "id")]]),
             Stratum = as.character(g("stratumName")),
             Selection_method = as.character(g("selectMeth")),
             numTotal = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g("numTotal"))),
             numSamp = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g("numSamp"))))
}))
nodes[is.na(Stratum) | Stratum == "", Stratum := "(none)"]

# PSU strata in calendar order when they are month names, else in order of appearance
psuStrata <- unique(nodes[level == 1][order(id), Stratum])
mo <- match(tolower(psuStrata), tolower(c(month.name, month.abb)))
if (all(!is.na(mo))) psuStrata <- psuStrata[order((mo - 1) %% 12)]

kids <- split(nodes[order(id)]$nodeKey, nodes[order(id)]$parent)
ordKeys <- character(0)
ordGroup <- character(0)
visit <- function(k, grp) {
  ordKeys <<- c(ordKeys, k)
  ordGroup <<- c(ordGroup, grp)
  for (ch in kids[[k]]) visit(ch, grp)
}
for (s in psuStrata) {
  for (r in nodes[level == 1 & Stratum == s][order(id), nodeKey]) visit(r, s)
}
tree <- nodes[match(ordKeys, nodeKey)]
tree[, Group := ordGroup]
tree[, Unit := paste0("<span style=\"padding-left:", (level - 1) * 1.4, "em\">",
                      ifelse(level == 1, "<b>", ""), Unit, ifelse(level == 1, "</b>", ""), "</span>")]
treeTab <- tree[, .(Unit, Stratum, Selection_method, numTotal, numSamp)]
k <- kableExtra::kbl(treeTab, format = "html", escape = FALSE,
                     col.names = gsub("_", " ", names(treeTab)), format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                     caption = paste0("Selected units by stage, each under the unit it was selected from (",
                                      paste(stageTabs, collapse = " &rarr; "), "), grouped by ", psuTab,
                                      " stratum. numTotal is the number of units available in the stratum within the parent unit ",
                                      "and numSamp the number selected, as reported on the record."))
k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = TRUE, position = "left")
for (s in psuStrata) {
  w <- which(tree$Group == s)
  k <- kableExtra::pack_rows(k, paste(psuTab, "stratum", s), min(w), max(w), label_row_css = "")
}
k <- sub("<table class=\"", "<table class=\"overview tree ", k)
structure(paste0("<div class=\"scroll-wrap\" style=\"max-height:640px; overflow-y:auto\">", k, "</div>"),
          class = "knit_asis")
```

# Landings and effort

```{r landings, fig.height = 4.5, results = "asis"}
lumpMetier <- function(m, w) {
  top <- data.table(m = m, w = w)[, .(w = sum(w)), by = m][order(-w)][seq_len(min(.N, params$topMetiers)), m]
  ifelse(m %in% top, m, "Other")
}
metierFill <- function(levels) {
  cols <- seriesCols[seq_len(min(length(levels), length(seriesCols)))]
  names(cols) <- levels[seq_along(cols)]
  if ("Other" %in% levels) cols["Other"] <- otherCol
  cols
}
stackedBars <- function(d, y, lev, ylab, title, subtitle, labFun) {
  d[, Metier := factor(Metier, levels = lev)]
  tot <- d[, .(y = sum(get(y))), by = Quarter]
  ggplot(d, aes(Quarter, .data[[y]], fill = Metier)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.55, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = tot, aes(Quarter, y, label = labFun(y)),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", colour = ink) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = fmtN, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = metierFill(lev)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, fill = NULL, title = title, subtitle = subtitle)
}
if (!is.null(CL)) {
  cat("## Landings\n\n")
  CL[, Metier := lumpMetier(CLmetier6, t)]
  lev <- CL[, .(t = sum(t)), by = Metier][order(Metier == "Other", -t), Metier]
  d <- CL[CLcatchCat == "Lan", .(t = sum(t)), by = .(Quarter = paste0("Q", CLquar), Metier)]
  print(stackedBars(d, "t", lev, "Landings (t)",
                    paste("Landings by quarter and metier,", dataYear),
                    "CL scientific weight, catch category Lan. Labels show the quarter total.",
                    function(x) paste(fmtT(x), "t")))

  clTab <- CL[, .(Official_t = sum(CLoffWeight) / 1000,
                  Scientific_t = sum(CLsciWeight) / 1000),
              by = .(Quarter = CLquar, Area = CLarea, Metier6 = CLmetier6,
                     Catch_category = CLcatchCat, Landing_category = CLlandCat)][
                       order(Quarter, Area, -Scientific_t)]
  show(kbl(clTab, digits = 1,
           caption = "Landings (CL) by quarter, area, metier and category."))
  basis <- CL[, .(Scientific_t = sum(t)),
              by = .(Data_basis = CLdBasSciWeig, Data_source = CLdSouSciWeig)]
  show(kbl(basis, digits = 1, caption = "Data basis and source of the scientific weight in CL."))
} else {
  cat("No CL data in the input.\n\n")
}
```

```{r coverage, fig.height = 4.5}
cs <- su[include == TRUE,
```

```{r lengthWeight, fig.height = 4.2}
    any(!is.na(fish$WeightMeasured) & !is.na(fish$Length))) {
  lw <- fish[!is.na(WeightMeasured) & !is.na(Length) & WeightMeasured > 0 & Length > 0]

          labs(x = "Length (mm)", y = "Weight (g)", title = "Length and weight",
               subtitle = paste0(fmtN(nrow(lw)), " fish. Orange line: W = ",

                                 ", fitted on the log scale.")))
}
```

```{r sexMaturity, fig.height = 3.8}
catPlot <- function(var, title) {
  if (is.null(fish) || !var %in% names(fish) || all(is.na(fish[[var]]))) return(NULL)
  d <- fish[!is.na(get(var)), .(n = .N), by = .(quarter, Value = get(var))]
  d[, N := sum(n), by = quarter]
  lev <- sort(unique(as.character(d$Value)))
  d[, Value := factor(Value, levels = lev)]
  k <- seq_len(min(length(lev), length(seriesCols)))
  cols <- setNames(seriesCols[k], lev[k])
  inkCols <- setNames(seriesInk[k], lev[k])
  d[, labCol := inkCols[as.character(Value)]]
  ggplot(d, aes(n / N, paste0("Q", quarter), fill = Value)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6,
             position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n / N >= 0.06, paste0(n, "/", N), ""), colour = labCol),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE), size = 2.8) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = pctLab, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#ececec", linewidth = 0.4)) +
    labs(x = "Percentage", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = title,
         subtitle = "Labels show n/N fish in the quarter")
}
```

# Appendix {-}

```{r appendix}
# Descriptions and definitions from "RDBES Documentation of the Data Model"
# (1 April 2026), section "Description of each table" (DE to SA, SD, VD, SL,
# FM, BV), section "Vessel Details and Species List" (IS) and section
# "Aggregated Commercial Landings (CL) and Commercial Effort (CE)" (CL, CE).
# Comparisons with the old RDB format (HH, SL, CS) are left out.
tabInfo <- data.table(
  Table = c("DE", "SD", "OS", "LO", "TE", "FT", "LE", "VS", "FO", "SS", "SA", "FM", "BV",
            "VD", "SL", "IS", "CL", "CE"),
  Name = c("Design", "Sampling details", "On-shore event", "Location", "Temporal event",
           "Fishing trip", "Landing event", "Vessel selection", "Fishing operation",
           "Species selection", "Sample", "Frequency measure", "Biological variable",
           "Vessel details", "Species list details", "Individual species",
           "Commercial landings", "Commercial effort"),
  Definition = c(
    "This table holds the information about the sampling scheme and stratification thereof. Further it specifies the upper hierarchy, which is unique for a given combination of sampling scheme and stratification.",
    "This table holds information on the sampling country and institute.",
    "If one of the sampling units is a combination of Location and Time, then this is where to put the information about the selection. Definition: Location*time, e.g. port-day, market-day, auction-day and factory-day.",
    "If one of the sampling units is a location, then this is where to put the information about the selection. The location refers to a place with LOCODE.",
    "If one of the sampling units is some kind of time e.g., minute, week or quarter, then this is where to put the information about the selection.",
    "This table holds information about the fishing trip. Definition: Any voyage of a fishing vessel during which fishing activities are intended that starts at the moment when the fishing vessel leaves a port and ends on arrival in port.",
    "This table holds information about the landing event. It is not assumed that one is sampling from all the landings of a fishing trip because there may be e.g. landings and sales taking place elsewhere. Definition: Landings from a fishing trip or part thereof.",
    "If one of the sampling units is a vessel, then this is where to put the information about the selection.",
    "This table holds information about the fishing operation. Definition: set/haul.",
    "This table holds information about the selection of species expected in the Sample (SA) table e.g., only species from a national species list are sampled, full concurrent species sampling, probabilistic species selection from a species group.",
    "This table holds outcome of the sampling done in the upper hierarchy, i.e. the final sample of fish available for measurement or biological analyses.",
    "This table holds the length distribution of the subsample from Sample (SA).",
    "This table holds the biological measurement done on individual fish e.g., weight, age, maturity and stock. Each line holds a single measurement.",
    "This table holds information about the vessel properties e.g. homeport and vessel length.",
    "This table holds information about the list of species which are targeted during a sampling event.",
    "Individual species records in a species list name (SL).",
    "Aggregated landings data from national commercial fisheries, with official and scientific estimates.",
    "Aggregated effort data from national commercial fisheries, with official and scientific estimates."))
present <- names(dat)[vapply(names(dat), function(t) nr(dat[[t]]) > 0, logical(1))]
tabInfo <- tabInfo[Table %in% c(presentTabs, present)]
tabInfo[, Order := match(Table, c(presentTabs, "VD", "SL", "IS", "CL", "CE"))]
setorder(tabInfo, Order)
tabInfo[, Order := NULL]
tabInfo[, Table := paste0("<b>", Table, "</b>")]
kbl(tabInfo, escape = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("RDBES tables in this report, in hierarchy order (hierarchy ", hier, ": ",
                     paste(presentTabs, collapse = " &rarr; "),
                     "). Definitions from the RDBES Documentation of the Data Model."))
```
